veldregel: Exploration field — 6 of 15 derived candidates: chain budget 8, positions centre-first (the window centre and its nearest neighbours), one alignment per handover, the same requirements as the full field. Plus 6 mirrored polarity arms: the same positions with a handover the other way round, designed and tuned in their own right and judged by the same gates (H-4).
notities: The derivation offered 15 candidates and the stated budget is 8; 6 are delivered. POSITIONS were thinned, per axis and per order, from the OUTSIDE in: the window centre and its nearest neighbours survive, the cages stay one spacing wide, and the band beyond the survivors is simply not explored (E-2 exploration). ORDERS were not thinned and will not be: a position is a sample of a continuum, an order is a choice, and dropping a choice to fit a budget answers a question that was asked to stay open.

Polarity arms: 6 mirrored candidates beside the 6 the field derived — 12 runs in total, and THE CHAIN BUDGET DOES NOT BOUND THEM. It thins POSITIONS, and an arm is not a position: it is the other half of a position the derivation already offered, and the run count multiplies by two per handover that has one rather than adding. Exploration: the textbook arm and the SINGLE-DRIVER REVERSAL unconditionally (the mid of a three-way, the tweeter of a two-way — the move the literature names, H-4b), plus any further handover the pre-design phase reading leaves open at one unit of phase error. The full field runs every configuration regardless. Each arm is designed, synthesised and tuned against its own phase targets and judged by the same gates; the shortlist marks it and the table decides (H-4).

Polarity arms the margin did not admit: 2 of the 4 configurations a position with 2 handovers has. 2 ran — the textbook arm and the single-driver reversal run unconditionally (H-4b), and the pre-design phase reading admitted the rest it left open. The reading at each crossing is printed below; nothing was refused on it, and the full field runs every configuration regardless.
